title: Sponsor a Programme
intro: Local businesses help us give young people in Darlington chances they'd otherwise never get. Choose a programme, pick a package, and we'll show you exactly what your support made possible.

story.heading: Why we do this
story.text: A young man we work with had lived in the shadow of Roseberry Topping his whole life and never once been up it. No car to get there, no one to climb it with, no one to show him where to start. A few weeks into one of our outdoor courses, we stood on the top together. Sponsors make days like that possible.

benefits: An impact summary for your CSR reporting
The option of an outdoor staff volunteering day
cicNote: As a community interest company, a third of our profit goes straight back into the community.

programmes.name: Creatureverse: Rift Battles
programmes.summary: A hands-on creative programme where young people design their own creatures, turn them into 3D-printed models, create trading cards and collector packaging, then battle them in our own Rift Battles arena and final tournament. Learners work towards an AQA Unit Award Scheme (UAS) award. We arrange dates once the cohort is formed.
programmes.imageAlt: Creatureverse creatures at every stage: a hand-drawn sketch, a 3D model on a laptop, painted 3D-printed figures, boxed collectibles and trading cards

programmes.name: ECO//FUTURE
programmes.summary: Help ten home-educated young people design and build a more sustainable home. Over ten weekly two-hour sessions, learners work from a client brief: they decide where to place solar panels, work out how much rainwater a roof could collect, and turn their drawings into a physical scale model. At the final showcase they present their home and explain the decisions behind it. Once the cohort is fully funded, places are free for families, with materials and equipment included.
